decisions.reason: The color-reference change does not alter the existing DJ-inspired control styling or bowl measurement markings.
This Requirement already records the same message's distinct visual-character change and resumption; the machine color reference belongs to the separate color-and-finish Requirement.
The referenced machine colors do not change the independently established requirement for decorative lighting.
The color-reference change does not modify the placard title, position, viewing orientation, display sides, or wording.
The general machine color reference does not override or otherwise change the established cursive beige E markings.
The source Event concerns colors shown on the machine, not the support base's separately specified beige reference finish.
Changing the machine's color reference does not alter its size, thickness, or accepted enclosure form.
Machine color and finish have no necessary effect on the specified materials for food-contact components.
The machine color-reference change does not modify the support base's font color, logo composition, lettering case, or font.
The machine color reference does not change the spout's appearance reference, material, or fabrication method.
The color-and-finish decision does not affect bowl depth, capacity, or the accepted need for refilling.
The machine color reference does not change splash-control targets, speed conditions, or mitigation options.
